title: Subfunctors of algebraic spaces satisfying the axioms are algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: By lemma-finite-dimension the target G satisfies [3], and injectivity of F -> G transfers [3] to F; injectivity also identifies U x_F V = U x_G V for maps into F, so Delta_F is representable by schemes because Delta_G is; the set-theoretic condition [-1] transfers from G, and the functor diagonal proposition concludes F is an algebraic space.
